english: you’ve hit the nail on the head
also: hit the nail on the head

evidence: Plaut. Rud. 5.2.19: tetigistī acū (Lewis & Short s.v. tangō)
terms.comment: Literally “you have touched the thing with a needle”. Traupman’s order is acū rem tetigistī.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
